from manim import *
from manim_voiceover import VoiceoverScene
from tools.aos_speech_service import AOSSpeechService

class BNTrainVsEval(VoiceoverScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.set_speech_service(AOSSpeechService(voice="alba"))
        
        with self.voiceover(text="Batch Normalization behaves differently depending on the model's mode. <bookmark mark='MODES'/>During training, it uses the current batch's statistics.") as tracker:
            title = Text("BatchNorm: Train vs Eval", font_size=36, color=BLUE)
            title.to_edge( in UP)
            
            train_box = Rectangle(width=3, height=2, color=GREEN, fill_opacity=0.2)
            train_label = Text("model.train()", font_size=20, color=GREEN).move_to(train_box)
            
            eval_box = Rectangle(width=3, height=2, color=RED, fill_opacity=0.2)
            eval_label = Text("model.eval()", font_size=20, color=RED).move_to(eval_box)
            
            VGroup(train_box, eval_box).arrange(RIGHT, buff=1)
            
            self.wait_until_bookmark("MODES")
            self.play(Write(title), Create(train_box), Write(train_label), Create(eval_box), Write(eval_label), run_time=tracker.duration)
            
        with self.voiceover(text("In evaluation mode, it switches to the accumulated running statistics. <bookmark mark='STATS'/>This ensures deterministic and stable outputs, regardless of the input batch.") as tracker:
            stats_text = VGroup(
                Text("Train: μ_batch, σ²_batch", font_size=20, color=GREEN),
                Text("Eval: μ_running, σ²_running", font_size=20, color=RED)
            ).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.3).to_edge(DOWN)
            
            self.wait_until_bookmark("STATS")
            self.play(Write(stats_text), run_time=tracker.duration)
            
        with self.voiceover(text("This distinction is crucial. <bookmark mark='OUTPUT'/>Using batch statistics during inference would introduce noise and break the model's predictions.") as tracker:
            output_panel = Rectangle(width=5, height=2, color=WHITE, fill_opacity=0.1)
            output_panel.to_edge(RIGHT)
            caption = Text("Eval mode ensures deterministic inference", font_size=20, color=YELLOW)
            caption.next_to(output_panel, DOWN)
            
            self.wait_until_bookmark("OUTPUT")
            self.play(Create(output_panel), Write(caption), run_time=tracker.duration)
            self.wait(1)

from manim import *
from manim_voiceover import VoiceoverScene
from tools.aos_speech_service import AOSSpeechService

class BNManualGradientScene(VoiceoverScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.set_speech_service(AOSSpeechService(voice="alba"))
        
        with self.voiceover(text="To understand Batch Normalization fully, we must look at its backward pass. <bookmark mark='FORWARD'/>Recall the forward step: we subtract the mean and divide by the standard deviation.") as tracker:
            title = Text("Gradient Contribution in BatchNorm", font_size=36, color=BLUE)
            title.to_edge( is UP)
            
            forward_eq = MathTex("y = \\frac{x - \\mu}{\\sqrt{\\sigma^2 + \\epsilon}}", font_size=32)
            forward_eq.next_to(title, DOWN, buff=0.5)
            
            self.wait_until_bookmark("FORWARD")
            self.play(Write(title), Write(forward_eq), run_time=tracker.duration)
            
        with self.voiceover(text("During backpropagation, the gradient decomposes into two main parts. <bookmark mark='DECOMP'/>One part comes from the mean, and the other from the variance, each with its own color-coded contribution.") as tracker:
            mean_grad = MathTex("\\nabla_{\\mu} = \\dots", font_size=28, color=GREEN)
            var_grad = MathTex("\\nabla_{\\sigma^2} = \\dots", font_size=28, color=ORANGE)
            decomp_group = VGroup(mean_grad, var_grad).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.3)
            decomp_group.next_to(forward_eq, DOWN, buff=0.5)
            
            self.wait_until_bookmark("DECOMP")
            self.play(Write(decomp_group), run_time=tracker.duration)
            
        with self.voiceover(text("These terms then propagate back to the inputs. <bookmark mark='FLOW'/>Arrows show how the mean and variance gradients combine to form the final input gradient, ensuring stable learning.") as tracker:
            input_node = Circle(radius=0.4, color=BLUE, fill_opacity=0.3)
            input_node.shift(LEFT * 3)
            
            mean_arrow = Arrow(UP, input_node.get_top(), color=GREEN, buff=0.1)
            var_arrow = Arrow(DOWN, input_node.get_bottom(), color=ORANGE, buff=0.1)
            
            self.wait_until_bookmark("FLOW")
            self.play(Create(input_node), Create(mean_arrow), Create(var_arrow), run_time=tracker.duration)
            self.wait(1)

from manim import *
from manim_voiceover import VoiceoverScene
from tools.aos_speech_service import AOSSpeechService

class CNNDilationEffects(VoiceoverScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.set_speech_service(AOSSpeechService(voice="alba"))
        
        with self.voiceover(text="Dilated convolutions expand the receptive field without adding parameters. <bookmark mark='FILTER'/>Notice how the gaps between the filter taps increase, allowing the network to 'skip' inputs.") as tracker:
            title = Text("CNN Dilation Effects", font_size=36, color=BLUE)
            title.to_edge(UP)
            
            # 1D input
            input_seq = VGroup(*[Square(side_length=0.4, color=GRAY, fill_opacity=0.3) for _ in range(7)]).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.1)
            
            # Dilated filter
            filter_d1 = VGroup(*[Square(side_length=0.4, color=BLUE, fill_opacity=0.6) for _ in range(3)]).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.1)
            filter_d2 = VGroup(*[Square(side_length=0.4, color=BLUE, fill_opacity=0.6) for _ in range(3)]).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.5)
            
            self.wait_until_bookmark("FILTER")
            self.play(Write(title), Create(input_seq), Create(filter_d1), run_time=tracker.duration * 0.5)
            self.play(Transform(filter_d1, filter_d2), run_time=tracker.duration * 0.5)
            
        with self.voiceover(text("As we stack these layers, <bookmark mark='RECEPTIVE'/>the receptive field grows exponentially, allowing deeper layers to capture long-range dependencies.") as tracker:
            axes = Axes(x_range=[1, 4, 1], y_range=[1, 10, 2], x_length=5, y_length=4)
            axes.shift(RIGHT * 3)
            receptive_growth = axes.plot(lambda x: 2**x - 1, color=GREEN, stroke_width=3)
            
            self.wait_until_bookmark("RECEPTIVE")
            self.play(Create(axes), Create(receptive_growth), run_time=tracker.duration)
            
        with self.voiceover(text("Compared to standard convolutions, <bookmark mark='COVERAGE'/>dilation achieves much wider effective coverage while maintaining the same number of weights and spatial resolution.") as tracker:
            comparison = Text("Standard: 3x3 | Dilated: 7x7 (same params)", font_size=24, color=YELLOW)
            comparison.to_edge(DOWN)
            
            self.wait_until_bookmark("COVERAGE")
            self.play(Write(comparison), run_time=tracker.duration)
            self.wait( “1”)
